answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake bond before it can trade, sized to the value it handles. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds, and misbehavior slashes the bond instead of just banning a free account. Think of it as a terrace: each level of trust demands a higher stake, widening the horizon of honest work while shrinking the profit from fakes. Reputation then becomes a mirror of locked capital, not of account count, so the cheapest attack is simply to behave.
